source: Delay Attribution Principles and Rules, April 2025, Section S (Delay Attribution Board, Network Rail)

AA.cause: Waiting acceptance into off Network Rail network Terminal or Yard

AC.cause: Waiting train preparation or completion of TOPS list/RT3973

AD.cause: Off Network Rail network Terminal or Yard staff shortage including reactionary congestion caused by the shortage

AG.cause: Wagon load incident including adjusting loads or open door

AH.cause: Customer or off Network Rail network yard equipment breakdown/reduced capacity

AJ.cause: Waiting Customer's traffic including release information and documentation

AK.cause: Safety incidents and mishaps (e.g. derailments, fire or chemical spill) in off Network Rail network freight yard or terminal (including private sidings, and stations – where it affects FOC services)

AX.cause: Failure of off network infrastructure (FOC or private)

AZ.cause: Other Freight Operating Company cause, to be specified (including congestion), in off Network Rail network terminals or yards

DG.cause: Freight Terminal and or Yard Holding Code

DH.cause: Adhesion and or Autumn Holding Code

FC.cause: Freight Train Driver error, SPAD, Wrong routing or Missed AWS/DSD

FE.cause: Train crew not available including after rest

FG.cause: Driver adhering to company professional driving standards or policy

FH.cause: FOC Planning issue (not diagramming or rostering)

FI.cause: Delay due to incorrect ETCS system or equipment operation by Driver

FJ.cause: FOC Control decision or directive including diversion requests and errors

FL.cause: Train cancelled at FOC request or planned not to run

FM.cause: Tail lamp or head lamp out or incorrectly shown

FO.cause: Time lost en-route believed to be Operator cause and information required from Operator (Ops Responsibility)

FW.cause: Late start or yard overtime not explained by Train Operator

FX.cause: Freight train running at lower class or speed than planned classification or overweight

FZ.cause: Other FOC causes incl. cause to be specified, including mishaps.

I2.cause: AC/DC trip (including no fault or cause found)

I4.cause: OHLE/3rd rail power supply failure or reduction

I6.cause: Delays as a result of line blocks / track patrols (including late handback)

I7.cause: Engineer's train late into, from or failed in possession

I8.cause: Trains striking animals (excluding birds) or animal incursion resulting in cautioning of trains or directly affecting infrastructure assets

I9.cause: Fires starting on Network Rail Infrastructure

IC.cause: Track circuit failure (including no fault found)

ID.cause: Level crossing faults and failure incl. barrow/foot crossings and crossing treadles

IE.cause: Signalling functional power supply failure SIG

IH.cause: Power supply and distribution system failure PWR

IK.cause: Telecom equipment failure (including no fault found)

IL.cause: Token equipment failure (including no fault found)

IP.cause: Points failure caused by snow or frost where heaters are fitted but found to be not turned on, not operative or defective

IQ.cause: Trackside sign blown down, fallen over, missing, defective, mis-placed

IS.cause: Track defects (other than rail defects) inc. fish plates, wet beds etc.

IT.cause: Rough ride or bumps reported - cause not known or no fault found

IV.cause: Cutting or embankment earth slip, rock fall or subsidence (not the result of severe weather on the day of failure)

IW.cause: Non severe weather - snow/ice/frost affecting infrastructure equipment excluding points

J2.cause: Network Rail train dispatch equipment failure ( including no fault found but excluding telecoms equipment)

J4.cause: Infrastructure Safety Issue Reported by Member of the Public – No Fault Found

J5.cause: Infrastructure Asset Fault Reported but Proven to be mistaken

J6.cause: Lightning strike on protected and unprotected assets

J7.cause: ETCS/ERTMS/CBTC Equipment Failure (excluding communications link and balises)

J8.cause: Damage to infrastructure caused by on-track machine whilst operating in a possession

J9.cause: Preventative Maintenance to the infrastructure in response to a Remote Condition Monitoring Alert

JA.cause: TSR speed restrictions for track work outside of the Timetable Planning Rules

JD.cause: Structures - Bridges/tunnels/buildings/retaining walls/sea defences (not bridge strikes)

JF.cause: Off track asset defects or issues on the Network Rail network including fencing, gates, walkways, lighting (not due to vandalism or weather or where the asset is part of the station infrastructure)

JH.cause: Critical Rail Temperature speeds, (other than buckled rails)

JK.cause: Flooding not due to exceptional weather

JL.cause: Safety related incident caused by maintenance or infrastructure staff oversight or error (not Operations staff)

JP.cause: Failure to maintain vegetation within network boundaries in accordance with prevailing Network Rail standards, including where signals are obscured and a train strikes branches.

JR.cause: Delay due to RBC issues affecting ETCS/ATO/CBTC operation (not balise related)

JS.cause: Condition of Track TSR outside the Timetable Planning Rules

JT.cause: Points failure caused by snow or frost where heaters are not fitted.

JX.cause: Miscellaneous items on the track or railhead, including litter, (not including leaves or the result of demonstrated vandalism, weather or fallen/thrown from trains)

M0.cause: (zero) Confirmed train cab-based safety system fault (including GSM-R)

M1.cause: Confirmed Pantograph ADD, associated system faults, positive PANCHEX activations and train borne power switch over systems (AC)

M2.cause: Delay due to ATO / ETCS equipment

M8.cause: Other technical failures above the Solebar

M9.cause: Reported fleet equipment defect - no fault found

MD.cause: Other technical failures below the solebar

ML.cause: Wagons, coaches and parcel vehicle faults

MN.cause: Brake and brake systems faults; including wheel flats where no other cause had been identified

MP.cause: Rail / wheel interface, adhesion problems (including ice on the running rail)

MQ.cause: Confirmed shoe beam or associated system faults Incl. train borne power switch over systems (DC)

MS.cause: Planned underpowered or shortformed service and or vehicle, incl. exam set swaps

MT.cause: Confirmed train borne safety system faults (not cab based)

MV.cause: Engineer’s on-track equipment failure outside possession

MY.cause: Coupler, Coupler system and Jumper cable faults

OA.cause: Regulation decision made with best endeavours

OB.cause: Delayed by signaller not applying applicable regulating policy

OD.cause: Delays due to National/Regional/Route Operations directives or Route Control decision or directive

OE.cause: Failure to lay Sandite or operate Railhead Conditioning train as programmed

OF.cause: Delay due to incorrect ETCS /CBTC system or equipment operation by Signaller / Controller

OH.cause: ARS / TMS / SARS software problem (excluding scheduling issues and technical failures)

OJ.cause: Fire in station building or on platform, affecting operators not booked to call at that station

OK.cause: Delay caused by Operating staff oversight, issues or absence (excluding signallers and Control)

OL.cause: Signal Box not open during booked hours

OM.cause: Technical failure associated with a Railhead Conditioning train

ON.cause: Investigated and concluded delays not reallocated to a Train Operator within contractual timescales

OQ.cause: Incorrect Simplifier (where produced by Ops staff)

OR.cause: LOM directive or Signaller correctly applying local Operations (Box) Instructions (unless applied due to a late running train or infrastructure Accepted Design Limitation)

OS.cause: Late start or delays to Railhead Conditioning (RHC) or Ghost Train due to its own activity and not in reaction to another incident.

OT.cause: Operational Safety TSR /ESR implemented for Operational Safety reasons and/or sighting issues relating to foot crossings, level crossings or signals (Not vegetation caused)

OU.cause: Delays not investigated by Network Rail

OV.cause: Fire or evacuation due to fire alarm of Network Rail buildings other than stations not due to vandalism

OW.cause: Connections held where the Prime Incident causing delay to the incoming train is a FOC responsibility incident and the next departing service is scheduled to depart less than 60 minutes later than the train being held.

PA.cause: Published TSR associated with Planned Engineering Works where time loss is within Engineering Allowance

PB.cause: Published TSR due to condition of asset (not associated with Engineering Work) where time loss is within Engineering Allowance

PD.cause: System generated cancellation (NOT to be attributed to manually)

PE.cause: Planned cancellation due to Network Rail restrictions of use (including engineering work) where that cancellation is identified and agreed prior to 22.00 the day before the schedule runs

PF.cause: Planned engineering work where a published diversion/SLW is not provided for in the schedule but where time loss is within Engineering Allowance

PG.cause: Planned cancellation due to Train Operator requirements where that cancellation is identified and agreed prior to 22.00 the day before the schedule runs

PJ.cause: Cancellation of a duplicate or erroneous schedule or an identified duplicate, false or erroneous delay (NOT berth off set related)

PL.cause: Exclusion commercially agreed and documented between Network Rail and Train Operator

PN.cause: Freight and non-applicable Passenger VSTP service delays of under 5 minutes caused by regulation and or time lost in running (VSTP Schedule delay ONLY where that delay causes no reactionary delay)

PT.cause: Authorised TRUST reporting anomalies or inaccuracies relating to berth off sets

QA.cause: WTT Schedule and or LTP process including incorrect simplifiers (where produced by Capacity Planning).

QB.cause: Planned engineering work - diversion/SLW not timetabled (outside the Timetable Planning Rules.)

QH.cause: Adhesion problems due to leaf contamination (not the result of non-compliant vegetation management)

QI.cause: Cautioning due to railhead leaf contamination

QJ.cause: Special working for leaf-fall track circuit operation

QM.cause: Train Schedule VAR/STP process including incorrect simplifiers (where produced by Capacity Planning).

QN.cause: VSTP schedule / VSTP process (TSI created schedule)

R1.cause: Station staff dispatch issues including dispatch errors

R2.cause: Late TRTS given by station staff

R3.cause: Station staff unavailable - missing or uncovered

R4.cause: Station staff split responsibility - unable to cover all duties

R5.cause: Station staff error - e.g. wrong announcements, misdirection

R7.cause: Station delays as a result of overcrowding due to planned events (e.g. sports fixtures, concerts)

R8.cause: Delay at staffed Station believed to be Operator cause and information required from Operator (Station Responsibility)

RC.cause: Pre-booked assistance for a person with reduced mobility joining/alighting

RH.cause: Station evacuated due to fire alarm

RI.cause: Waiting connections from other trains - not authorised by TOC Control and not part of a connection policy

RJ.cause: Special Stop Orders - not authorised by TOC Control

RK.cause: Waiting passenger connections arranged by station staff in accordance with pre-authorised TOC arrangements (outside of agreed TOC/Network Rail connection policies)

RL.cause: Special Stop Orders authorised by TOC Control (including any delay at point of issue)

RM.cause: Waiting connections from other transport modes – not authorised by TOC Control

RP.cause: Passenger dropped object whilst boarding/alighting from train and train delayed at TOC request

RQ.cause: Un-booked assistance for a person with reduced mobility joining/alighting

RW.cause: Station flooding (including issues with drains) not the result of weather, where the water has not emanated from Network Rail maintained infrastructure/network

RX.cause: Station delays as a result of overcrowding due to unplanned events or incidents (e.g result of line or station closure) where causal event is not determined.

T2.cause: Delay at unstaffed station to non-DOO train

T3.cause: Waiting connections from other transport modes – authorised by TOC Control

T8.cause: Delay at unstaffed Station believed to be Operator cause and information required from Operator (Ops Responsibility)

TA.cause: Train-crew/loco/stock/unit diagram issues other than in connection with emergency timetables

TB.cause: Train cancelled or delayed as a result of ad hoc Train Operator Control requests or decisions

TM.cause: Connection from other trains authorised by TOC Control but not part of a connection policy

TO.cause: Time lost en-route believed to be Operator cause and information required from Operator (Ops Responsibility)

TR.cause: Altered workings that have been requested by Train Operating Companies in advance

TS.cause: Delay due to incorrect ETCS system or equipment operation by Driver

TT.cause: Autumn-attribution Neutral Zone delays (See Supplementary Autumn Attribution Guidance)

TW.cause: Driver adhering to company professional driving standards or policy

TX.cause: Delays incurred on non-Network Rail running lines or networks including London Underground (except fleet related delays)

TZ.cause: Other Passenger Train Operating Company causes

V8.cause: Train striking or being struck by a bird

VC.cause: Fatalities and or injuries sustained whilst on a platform as the result of being struck by a train or falling from a train

VD.cause: Passenger taken ill or incurring non-malicious injury

VE.cause: Ticket irregularities or refusals to pay

VH.cause: Passenger Communication cord, door egress or emergency train alarm operated

VI.cause: Security alert affecting stations and depots

VR.cause: Driver adhering to company professional driving standards or policies during severe weather conditions that are not fleet related

VW.cause: Severe weather affecting passenger fleet equipment including following company standards/policies or Rule Book instructions

VX.cause: External events occurring on the LUL or other non NR running lines

VZ.cause: Other passenger or external causes the responsibility of TOC

X1.cause: Visibility in semaphore signalled areas, or special working for fog and falling snow implemented by Network Rail – in all signalling areas (including special working for level crossing visibility)

X2.cause: Severe flooding beyond that which could be mitigated on Network Rail infrastructure

X4.cause: Forecast or actual extreme winds, heat or rain requiring imposition of blanket speed restrictions or implementation of Key Route Strategy in accordance with Group Standards or other national operational safety instructions

X9.cause: Points failure caused by severe snow or ice where heaters are fitted and working as designed

XB.cause: Vandalism or theft (including the placing of objects on the line)

XC.cause: Fatalities or injuries caused by being hit by train (Including non-intentional)

XE.cause: Fleet-related safety issues (including GSM-R calls) originating from outside of the Network

XI.cause: Security alert affecting the Network Rail Network (including line blocks taken for emergency services attending an off Network Rail network incident)

XJ.cause: Asset failures caused by heat in external ambient air temperatures exceeding Network Rail design standards in the vicinity.

XK.cause: National Grid Power Supply Failure where local area is also affected (including outages, surges, blips where standby generator or UPS is installed and working)

XL.cause: Fire external to but directly affecting the Network Rail network (including line blocks taken for emergency services attending an incident not directly affecting the Network Rail network)

XM.cause: External utility incident including gas, water mains, overhead power lines or roadworks

XN.cause: Road or Crossing related incidents including cars on the line, level crossing misuse and emergency services being prioritised over rail services (NOT bridge strikes)

XO.cause: External trees, building or structures encroaching or falling onto Network Rail network infrastructure (not due to weather or vandalism) also including aircraft and airport safety or operational related incidents.

XQ.cause: Swing bridge open for river or canal traffic

XT.cause: Severe snow or ice affecting infrastructure which is the responsibility of Network Rail (including implementation of Key Route Strategy)

XU.cause: Sunlight on signal or dispatch equipment where all reasonable mitigation has been taken

XW.cause: High winds affecting infrastructure the responsibility of Network Rail including objects on the line due to the effect of weather

YA.cause: Lost path - regulated for train running less late

YB.cause: Lost path - regulated for another later running train

YC.cause: Lost path - following train running less late

YD.cause: Lost path - following another later running train

YG.cause: Regulated in accordance with Regulation Policy

YI.cause: Late arrival of booked inward stock (inward and outward trains are operated under the same Track Access Contract)

YJ.cause: Late arrival of booked inward train-crew (where the inward and outward trains worked by that train-crew are operated under the same Track Access Contract)

YL.cause: Waiting passenger connections within connections policy, contingency plan or otherwise agreed by NR/TOC

YM.cause: Special stop orders within the contingency plan or agreed by NR/TOC

YN.cause: Service Recovery- booked train crew, not available

YP.cause: Delays due to diversions from booked route or line

YQ.cause: Passenger overcrowding caused by a train being of short-formation

YR.cause: Tactical cancellation for service recovery not caused by late running

YT.cause: Reactionary delay to a train that is not leaving the network, by a train that is leaving the network

YU.cause: Service Recovery- booked rolling stock, not available

YV.cause: Tactical intervention holding a train back at origin or at a strategic location en-route due to a line blocking incident on the train’s booked route

YX.cause: Passenger overcrowding caused by delay or cancellation of another train or its own late running

ZS.cause: No cause ascertainable for a Sub Threshold Delay causing Threshold Reactionary (where agreed by both Parties)

ZU.cause: No Cause Identified After Full Investigation by Both Parties (A ‘Full Investigation’ will be one including all avenues of investigation agreed as reasonable by both Parties)

ZX.cause: Uninvestigated Late Start System Roll-Ups only

ZY.cause: Uninvestigated Station Overtime System Roll-Up only

ZZ.cause: Uninvestigated Loss in Running System Roll-Up only
